messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT - eu-west-2 gateway elevated 5xx and timeouts. 10m avg errors 16%, p95 latency x3. Please ack and join.
Diego Ramos: ACK. I'm Diego on-call. Pulling live traces and recent config pushes.
Priya Patel: Noticed a spike in gateway 502/504 and TCP resets hitting the model shards. Start time ~09:42 UTC.
Tom Baker: Any infra changes?
InfraBot: Config push `route-table:v17` deployed to eu-west-2 at 09:39 by deploy-bot.
Diego Ramos: That lines up. Rolling routing changes can cause partial hit of stale shards. Priya, can you correlate errors to route-table changes?
Priya Patel: Correlation looks strong. Flapping starts immediately after v17. I see clients being routed to backend hosts that return "shard-mismatch" then 500.
Tom Baker: We should flip the route-table rollback. Can we do a config revert? If rollback is risky, enable fail-open to skip shard validation for impacted tenants.
Diego Ramos: Rolling strategy: 1) enable cross-region spill to eu-central-1 for new sessions (non-pinned) 2) set circuit-breaker for backend shard validation to return 503 quickly for retries 3) revert route-table to v16 in eu-west-2. Priya, trigger step 1. Tom, prep rollback.
Priya Patel: Applying spill rule now: `routeset spill --from eu-west-2 --to eu-central-1 --scope non-pinned --percent=30`
Ops Pager: Spill rule applied. eu-central-1 receiving ~28% EU traffic. No saturation there.
Priya Patel: Enabling fast-fail circuit-breaker on shard validation: `cfgctl set runtime.shard.validation.timeout=50ms` and `cfgctl set runtime.shard.validation.fail_fast=true`
InfraBot: Circuit-breaker config applied across eu-west-2.
Tom Baker: Starting route-table rollback to v16 in eu-west-2: `deployctl revert config/route-table --region eu-west-2 --to=v16`
incident-bot: Rollback initiated. Watchers: rollback-controller. Estimated 2m for propagation.
Priya Patel: Watching logs: within 90s after rollback start, error rate drops from 16% -> 6%. New 5xxs are mostly from older pinned sessions (we did not migrate pinned).
Diego Ramos: Good. Keep pinned sessions isolated. We'll avoid killing user sessions. Priya, gather error samples and place in the incident bucket.
Priya Patel: Uploaded samples: s3://incidents/1824567890/shard-errors.log. Errors show `shard-mismatch` and "validation: expected 0x3f, got 0xa2" across ~12 hosts.
Tom Baker: Rollback finished, routing table v16 restored. Health checks across gateway now green for 95% of hosts. A few hosts still have heap stalls from repeated retries.
Diego Ramos: Let's throttle retries at the gateway to avoid stomping backends. Set retry-limit to 2 and exponential backoff.
Priya Patel: Applying `gatewayctl set retry.max_attempts=2` and `gatewayctl set retry.backoff=exponential:200ms`
Ops Pager: Retry limits applied. Observed successful token-gen p95 back to baseline in ~7m.
CS-Notifier: Sending customer update: "We observed elevated errors in eu-west-2 due to a routing config regression and have applied mitigations (reroute + rollback). Engineering is investigating root cause. No data loss expected."
Diego Ramos: Assign postmortem owner. Tom, can you lead RCA?
Tom Baker: I'll own postmortem. Immediate RCA actions: reproduce route-table v17 in staging with pinned-session load, add unit test for shard validation mismatch, and add deploy gating for route-table changes. ETA initial draft 48h.
Priya Patel: One more note: KV cache telemetry spiked during the event as backend retries increased; sampling retained. Recommend increasing KV cache retention and adding alert when miss-rate > 2x baseline.
Diego Ramos: Add that to actions. Also expand canary tests for config pushes to include shard-consistency checks against long-context sessions.
Tom Baker: Agree. I'll add to postmortem tasks: canary expansion, improved revert runbook, and automate partial spill for non-pinned by default on critical config failures.
Diego Ramos: Lowering severity to P2 and handing off to Tom for postmortem. Keep channel open for 30m for regression monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident downgraded to P2; on-call handoff: Tom Baker.
Priya Patel: Monitoring now; metrics look stable but we'll keep high-frequency retention for 2h.
CS-Notifier: Follow-up customer note queued: "Systems stabilized; detailed postmortem will be shared in 48h."
Diego Ramos: Thanks team. If we see a regression, reopen this thread immediately.
Tom Baker: Thanks all, I'll assemble logs and timeline. Assigning postmortem doc and runbook updates. :document_with_text:
incident-bot: Thread will auto-archive in 7 days.
